roles.background: variations of Hodge structure, Hodge loci, monodromy
roles.assignment: check whether the reduced fixed-class branch may be treated algebraically and what local trivialization is required
roles.finding: after denominator clearing and a simply connected local chart, CDK supplies algebraicity for the fixed integral Hodge-class locus; this does not supply algebraic cycles
roles.objection: do not use Hodge-locus algebraicity as evidence for Hodge conjecture
roles.handoff: cycle-moduli role may treat T_red as the algebraic target only inside this scope

roles.background: Hilbert schemes, Chow groups, relative cycles
roles.assignment: encode arbitrary finite signed rational witnesses by countably many proper parameter spaces
roles.finding: fixed Hilbert-polynomial relative Hilbert spaces are proper; finite signed cycles after denominator clearing can be encoded by countably many finite Hilbert-product/coefficient data
roles.objection: an exact cohomology class must be imposed componentwise; Hilbert properness alone does not select α
roles.handoff: deformation role must verify class constancy on the selected connected strata

roles.background: deformation theory, incidence maps, obstruction semantics
roles.assignment: test whether unrestricted proper domination adds a first-order or all-order mechanism beyond pointwise witness existence
roles.finding: the proposed countable-cover argument is support-level and does not provide higher-Artin lifting; if valid it shows only that unrestricted dominance is target-equivalent at the pointwise reduced level
roles.objection: selected-witness persistence and nilpotent lifting remain separate
roles.handoff: adversarial role should try to break the countable-cover step with component switching or nonproperness

roles.assignment: ask whether a restricted geometrically generated witness family could escape the circularity
roles.finding: yes in principle: a source-specific bounded family produced independently by a correspondence/Lefschetz/normal-function/degeneration mechanism would be stronger search information than the unrestricted Hilbert universe
roles.objection: normal-function detector data alone still does not produce witnesses
roles.handoff: routing role should reopen PATH toward independently generated bounded witness families

roles.background: irreducibility, proper maps, countability arguments, pathological moduli
roles.assignment: attack countable closed-cover inference and coefficient/component bookkeeping
roles.finding: under the frozen uncountable-field, algebraic irreducible target and proper fixed-data strata hypotheses, a countable union of proper closed subsets cannot cover T_red; the fragile point is exact-class stratification, not countability itself
roles.objection: do not assert the exact-class stratum is algebraic without a local-system constancy argument; formulate it as a union of connected components on which the flat class is fixed
roles.handoff: formal role must state these assumptions explicitly rather than hiding them

roles.background: RAKL v3 gates, provenance, trace, novelty metrology
roles.assignment: separate episode, diagnosis, failure, lesson and successor; classify chronology and authority
roles.finding: candidate generation was retrospective relative to the v3 receipt; only the verification discriminator can receive prospective binding. The result is route-pruning/representation analysis, not mathematical novelty or root progress
roles.objection: parent PR #119 CI is already failing for application inventory reasons, so no promotion can be inferred from branch CI
roles.handoff: metrics must mark parent-CI blocker and causal RAKL attribution CANNOT_MEASURE

consensus: Execute the countable/proper closed-cover discriminator as a verification of a retrospectively generated candidate. If both implications hold under the frozen exact-class stratification assumptions, classify unrestricted H4d1d domination as a representation-equivalent target and route to a restricted independently generated witness family.
dissent_or_open_points: exact algebraicity/connected-component implementation of the flat-class condition should not be oversold
no statement about global monodromy or singular degeneration
no mathematical independence from known standard arguments is claimed
